question.text: Aravali Ventures Cat I AIF: Total Commitment INR 40 crore, Management Fee 1.5% on Total Committed Capital every year (per PPM, fixed base), excl. GST @ 18%. What is the TOTAL annual cost to the fund (including GST)?

answer.text: INR 88.50 lakh (scaled from Example 6.1: INR 50 cr case)

explanation.text: The Logic: Fee = 1.5% x INR 40 cr = INR 60 lakh. GST @ 18% = INR 60 x 0.18 = INR 10.80 lakh. Total = INR 70.80 lakh. (Example 6.1 in the chapter applies the same pattern to INR 50 crore.) The Trap: A stops before GST; C scales the example's total but forgets to re-base to 40 cr; D is 1.5% x 50 cr — wrong committed capital. Cross-Exam Context: Chapter 6 Example 6.1 arithmetic. XIX-C tests identical pattern. Manager's Pro-Tip: When presenting LP cost disclosures, show management fee as a PRE-GST line and GST as a separate line in the LP statement. This avoids confusion when LPs cross-check the fee against the PPM's headline rate.
